evidence.exact_quote:
def reseal(value):
    value = copy.deepcopy(value)
    value["id"] = f"{value['schema']}:{core.digest(value['payload'])}"
    value["integrity"] = core.digest({k: v for k, v in value.items() if k != "integrity"})
    return value
evidence.observation: reseal recomputes id/integrity over attacker-controlled payload; it restores self-consistency, not non-tampering. This is why validate_artifact's semantic recompute (not the hash) is what catches the tampering on this path.
